1479-4826-5700-5701-8293.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-8293.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-6797-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2226-2908-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2908-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5670-6094.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4871-5670-6094.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4881-5352-6909.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5352-6909.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

465-585-3499-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2150-3991-8095.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5170-6132-6797-7574.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-7892.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-7892.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1315-1479-7892.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2232-7827-7835-7836.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7835-7836.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

1770-3821-4415.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
1770-3821-4415.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2421-3705-4050-7646.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

585-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
585-4997-7414.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Pensive Professor to become a Merfolk or Knight until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

851-5742-5743-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.

Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.

When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2

628-2034-7214.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2730-3967-5237.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1350-4010-6723-6965.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-6965.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

4067-6657-6921.easyPrerequisites:
Biorganic Carapace is attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
4067-6657-6921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three modified creatures.
4067-6657-6921.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Biorganic Carapace attached, triggering it.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the creature's trigger.
Resolve the copy of the creature's ability, drawing a card for each modified creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Gogo.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.
4067-6657-6921.notes: Depending on how many modified creatures you control, you may draw more cards than is needed to continue the loop. You can choose to keep those cards or discard them for additional results.

2173-3239-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1621-2510-6867.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1621-2510-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3580-6798.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-6006-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

4120-4968-6627.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4120-4968-6627.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
4120-4968-6627.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

813-3378-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Illusionist's Stratagem.
813-3378-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

803-1432-1486-1753.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
803-1432-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability. You can also use Ioreth's second ability instead.

1429-3698-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3698-4452-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

804-2511-2533-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-2665-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-2665-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Progenitor Mimic and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Progenitor Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Progenitor Mimic to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Progenitor Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Progenitor Mimic by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
101-1987-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

527-2034-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-2034-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-2034-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1283-4893-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1283-4893-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

64-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
64-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
64-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Warden of the Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Warden of the Eye, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2646-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.

Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.

2440-2714-4758-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.

Activate Crossroads Candleguide four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2730-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.

When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Sand token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.

Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.

Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.

The Tattered Mummy and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
